### REQ-022: Input validation and multi-room UI fixes (iTime=0 NaN, encoder target fan-out)

## Requirement

Bundle of small correctness fixes from the 2026-07-02 migration review (finding F-10):

1. **`iTime = 0` → NaN actuator duty.** `Room::processJsonAsObj()` validates `pTol` but assigns `iTime` unchecked (`core/room.cpp:358-361`); `PidController`'s constructor computes `1 / (pTol * 60 * iTime)` (`control/pid.cpp:32`) → `inf` gain → NaN output → NaN `actuatorDuty_` with undefined `std::clamp` behavior. Reject `iTime == 0` (fall back to `hal::pid::ITIME_DEFAULT`) and clamp to a sane range. (Same hole existed in legacy `src/pid.cpp:118` — inherit-and-fix.)
2. **Encoder target reaches only the first room.** `UiAdapter::newTargetWasSet()` destructively clears the flag (`core/ui_adapter.h:64-66`) and is consumed inside per-room `Room::updateUi()` (`core/room.cpp:154`) — on multi-room devices only the first UI-enabled room receives the new target. Legacy read the flag once and fanned the target to all rooms (`src/thermo.cpp:207-216`). Consume the flag once in `Thermo::updateUi()` and pass the target to every room.
3. **Bound the `MessageQueue`.** `core/message.cpp:33-37` grows without limit; cap (e.g. 16 messages, drop-oldest with a warning log) to prevent heap exhaustion under a message flood.
